HOLD BACK: these moments belong to the open images — keep their events out of this setting, even as a distant figure or reflection: "음악이 터지는 순간 색색의 빛이 발밑에서 사방으로 번쩍인다"; "화살표 빛들이 소용돌이처럼 위로 쏟아져 올라간다"; "무대 위로 빛 기둥과 금빛 종이 조각이 한꺼번에 터진다". An object named in FORM or in her pose stays.

PRESENTATION: a polished, glamorous adult game card illustration — a beautiful face within her FACE structure; a dense, high-detail costume with glossy trim, clasps and jewelry framing her game's material; luminous rim light, strong value contrast.

STANCE (this form): "마지막 박자에 맞춰 한 발을 높이 차올리고 손가락으로 하늘을 가리키는 자세" — a grand final pose, seen from a slightly high, more distant camera, easy to read as a card.

EXPRESSION (ENDING): mouth open wide in a laugh with teeth showing and cheeks raised, but the eyes stay open and engaged — lids only slightly narrowed, gaze still readable rather than squeezed shut — the mood of this stage. This expression replaces the attached image's; keep only who she is.

OUTPUT: the ending form of the woman in the attached image, as a new card image. Do not reuse its outer garment or lining artwork — build the costume FORM describes. Build the background, light and camera from SETTING and STANCE — do not reuse the attached image's background, floor, lighting or camera angle. Vertical 2:3 frame (1024×1536), full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, nothing in front of her but what she holds, face toward the camera (front or three-quarter, never a back view).

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border, no game interface or score.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

HANDS: natural human hands. Her hands do only what STANCE says and hold only what it names. Her hands keep the same gloves or bare hands as in the attached image, unless FORM names gloves.
